title: Inside The Crazy Ant Farm
author: The Crazy Ant Films Company
description: Inside The Crazy Ant Farm is our weekly podcast. It provides a detailed look at the inner working of an independent production company. Okay, it's really more like seven "Crazy" guys and gals talking about the awesomeness of being indie filmmakers!! Every week we talk about our film projects, the latest industry news, weekend box office predictions and results, and the "Word of the Day"!! We also interview celebrity guests!
